name: St. Lau – Timeless 3BR Jungle Sanctuary in Ubud
comment: Our stay at St Lau Villa was absolutely wonderful! The villa looked exactly like the photos beautifully presented, clean, and up to standard in every way. From the very beginning, everything was smooth and welcoming. Our driver, Made, was amazing, he patiently waited for us despite our delayed arrival and made the transfer so easy. Our villa host, Mike, was truly exceptional. He greeted us warmly around midnight, gave us a full tour of the villa, and made sure we felt completely comfortable. His communication throughout our stay was fantastic, always kind, responsive, and willing to help with anything we needed. It really made a difference having such a caring and attentive host. The villa itself was a perfect escape from reality. We loved the quiet atmosphere, the stunning surroundings. We can’t thank the team enough for their hospitality and warmth. They made our time in Ubud 10x better, and we’d love to come back again soon!

name: Balangan Cliff Villa – Iconic 5BR Cliff-Edge Oceanfront Estate
comment: The location of the accommodation was great, the simple design was great, and I had a wonderful time in a wonderful accommodation that was free and without waste. It was more beautiful than it looked in the photos, and it was on the edge of a cliff, like a cafe in a resort. The staff was great, and they even found a toy my son had lost. The only thing was that the contact information I was given at the beginning was different from the villa's contact information, so I had a little trouble at first.After I was able to get in touch with the villa, the response was quick and helpful.

name: Villa Angkasa – Majestic 5BR Rainforest Infinity Villa in Ubud
comment: This villa in Ubud was absolutely stunning and perfect for our group stay. The property is beautifully designed, very spacious, and surrounded by the peaceful natural atmosphere that makes Ubud so special. The five bedrooms provided plenty of privacy and comfort for everyone, while the common areas were great for relaxing together. The pool and outdoor spaces made the experience even more memorable. Everything was clean, well maintained, and exactly as described. The villa truly felt like a private retreat while still being close enough to explore Ubud’s cafes, restaurants, and attractions. It was a relaxing and unforgettable stay, and I would highly recommend this villa for families or groups looking for a beautiful place to enjoy Ubud.

name: Villa Habitas – Serene 4BR Lagoon Sanctuary in Pererenan
comment: This villa was incredible- perfect location, close to restaurants and spas, walkable with a toddler which was great.  The villa staff were gorgeous and helpful. We’d stay there again.

name: Tranquil Sanctuary – Romantic 1BR Private Haven in Prime Pererenan
comment: We absolutely loved our stay! Ayu was incredibly kind, always available, and offered daily cleaning. The villa looked exactly as pictured, and the location was private yet convenient—just a 5-minute walk to some lovely cafes or a short bike ride to great restaurants. We really appreciated the additional bathroom, and the villa was the perfect size for two people. The only minor downside was the very tight curved staircase to the bedroom, but that wouldn’t stop us from coming back. Highly recommend!

name: Casa Kameeyla – Vibrant 4BR Tropical Villa in Central Canggu
comment: A beautiful family-friendly villa with stunning design and responsive hosting We had a wonderful stay at Casa Kameelya in Canggu. The villa was exactly as described light, airy, and beautifully designed. It offered a great indoor-outdoor flow and a private pool that was a real highlight for our family. As a group with four children, we found the space incredibly well thought-out and comfortable for family living. The host, Mr. G, was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, making everything seamless from check-in to check-out. The only consideration for families is the surrounding roads while the villa itself is peaceful and private, the nearby streets are quite busy with limited sidewalks, which made walking with children a bit tricky. That said, we were happy to use cars for most outings, so this wasn’t a major issue for us. Overall, a fantastic stay and a property we would absolutely recommend to other families looking for a stylish and relaxing base in Canggu.

name: Luxe Beach Villa – Chic 3BR Coastal Hideaway Steps from Seminyak Beach
comment: The villa's aesthetics are stunning at first glance. The high sloping roof and the large floor-to-ceiling glass windows create a sense of openness. The private pool is surrounded by tropical greenery. As soon as you walk into the yard, you are instantly enveloped by a relaxing holiday atmosphere. The view is full of greenery and clear pool water. Every photo you take is like an Instagram masterpiece. The interior space is spacious and comfortable. The large sunken sofa in the living room is perfect for relaxing and lying down. The wooden roof is complemented by simple and elegant soft furnishings, creating a high-end and cozy feel. The dining and kitchen area is neat and functional. The host provides fruit and specially prepared drinks here. You can enjoy a drink and chat while enjoying the beautiful view of the pool. The atmosphere is great, and the privacy is also very well maintained. There is absolutely no need to worry about being disturbed. You wouldn't get tired of lying here all day. The only minor drawback is that parking on the small road leading to the house is not particularly convenient. Otherwise, I really can't find any issues. The environment, design, comfort, and cleanliness are all impeccable. It's perfect for a relaxing holiday with friends and family. Next time I come, I will definitely choose this place again. Highly recommended for friends who want a slow-paced holiday!

name: Tropical Elegance – Breezy 2BR Ocean-Air Villa by Seseh Beach
comment: Villa Halle is a beautiful 2-bedroom villa in a quiet neighbourhood. From the moment we walked in, we loved the cozy and luxurious feel. The villa is newly built and features a big private pool with a moving water feature that creates gentle ripples  and soothing sound of running water adding to the relaxing ambiance while enhancing the pool’s visual appeal. The warm ambient lighting all over the villa at night creates a stunning atmosphere, just as charming as the daytime setting. You can tell a lot of thought went into the design, decor, and facilities—everything feels high-quality and well-planned. The host was very responsive and provided clear instructions, making our stay smooth and hassle-free. We had a fantastic time and would definitely love to come back in the future!

name: Yellow Moon – Sun-Drenched 3BR Tropical Sanctuary in Uluwatu
comment: This villa was ABSOLUTELY GORGEOUS for our family getaway 🥰 What truly stood out was how KID FRIENDLY it is. Our little one loved the pool accessories and toys, making the pool area both fun and safe. The spacious, clean and A VERY LARGE POOL had a shallow section as well perfect for kids.  beautifully furnished, spotless clean with cozy bedrooms and space for the kids to play indoors as well. My kid kept busy.  Check-in and hospitality was brilliant.  GOOD quality workout equipment.  Master bathroom was so luxurious.  Location is great! located in a quiet developing neighbourhood, still a 10-15min drive to the best beaches and all happening clubs, bars.   The fully equipped kitchen made our stay even easier, modern appliances and all the cookware we needed. This convenience allowed us to enjoy fresh, home-cooked food and relax without any hassle. They have private chef services too.  Comfortable and welcoming, I cannot recommend it enough for its quality and value. MUST VISIT 🥰🥰

name: CASA KĀYA – Bohemian 1BR Design Villa in Bingin
comment: Beautiful villa that looks even in person than the images. We arrived just after 9.00pm - the villa was perfectly lit. Jeki greeted up upon arrival along with a welcome drink and fruit platter.  Jeki gave us a short tour around the villa before departing.  The villa has a beautiful layout to take advantage of Bali’s weather. With sliding doors that open widely to make the space feel even bigger than it is. The outdoor pool size is perfect, and its position allows for all day sunlight - perfect for tanning.  The finishes of the villa, along with personal touches and being fully equiped has made it perfectly comfortable for our short stay - however would also be great for those looking to stay longer.  The location is very central, close to the golf course shortcut (for scooters) whilst also being so close to the best cafes around. The area is still being developed with construction right next to the villa and a little challenging for Gojek / grab to find at the moment

name: Luxury Tropical Bingin – Elegant 3BR Palm Villa Near Beach
comment: We had an amazing stay at this beautiful villa in Uluwatu! The villa was exactly as shown in the photos — clean, spacious, stylish, and very well maintained. The tropical vibe combined with the peaceful atmosphere made the stay truly relaxing. The location was excellent, close to beaches, cafes, and popular spots around Uluwatu while still feeling private and calm. The rooms were comfortable, the pool area was stunning, and everything was thoughtfully arranged for a luxury experience. The hosts were also incredibly responsive, helpful, and made the entire check-in/check-out process smooth and hassle-free. You can really tell they care about their guests’ experience. Would definitely recommend this villa to anyone visiting Bali, whether with friends or family. Thank you for the wonderful stay — would love to come back again!

name: Chic Tropical Bingin – Polished 2BR Concrete Oasis Near Beach
comment: We had a great stay and would happily recommend this villa. The property itself is very new, modern, clean and well appointed, with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay. The hosts were exceptionally responsive, friendly and easy to communicate with throughout our visit. A particularly thoughtful touch was the lovely birthday greeting they arranged during my stay, which was greatly appreciated. There was a minor plumbing maintenance issue during our visit, however it was attended to promptly. As noted in description, surrounding area is currently experiencing significant development and construction activity. While noise was not an issue during our stay, the outlook immediately outside the villa does include a number of active construction sites, which does impact the external aesthetics of the area. Overall, the quality of the accommodation, the responsiveness of the hosts and the standard of the villa itself made for a very enjoyable stay. Thank you again.

name: Umalas Estate – Grand 5BR Designer Haven Bordering Berawa
comment: Sanctuary privat baru dengan standar kenyamanan tertinggi di Bali.

name: Villa Imala – Ultra-Luxury 6BR Ocean-View Spa & Gym Estate in Uluwatu
comment: We had an absolutely amazing stay at this villa. Everything is brand new, and we were lucky enough to be the very first guests. The villa is beautiful, and the pool is fantastic, perfect for relaxing and spending time with friends. Our favorite moment was definitely the sunset. Sitting on the terrace, enjoying the ocean view at the end of the day, was simply magical. Uluwatu is our favorite area in Bali, and this place truly exceeded our expectations. The manager was outstanding and took great care of us, organizing massages, spa treatments, and even a special dinner. It was also a very special stay for me as I celebrated my birthday there with friends. The access road is still being finalized, but once you’re inside the villa, you enjoy complete privacy and tranquility. We highly recommend this place and would love to come back.

name: Villa Mahina – Contemporary 3BR Luxury Villa 400m from Berawa Beach
comment: Outstanding stay at Villa Mahina! The location in Canggu & Berawa is unbeatable, the private pool and living space were pristine.

name: Khaleela Villas – Desert-Inspired 2BR Sunlit Oasis in Canggu
comment: The villa I stayed in this time was exactly as shown in the photos, and in fact, the actual place was even more stunning than the photos!Everyone was excited as soon as they walked in; it was truly beautiful.The house manager, Dando, was friendly and considerate throughout. Not only did he proactively greet us and help us carry our luggage, but he also carefully loaded our luggage into the car when we left. He was very easy to get along with, and I felt at ease whenever I saw him. The room's swimming pool is clean and clear, but please be aware that the water depth is over 1.5 meters (about 5 feet), so please be careful.The kitchen was also very clean and tidy, and basic supplies such as drinking water were well stocked. We also took a lot of beautiful photos here. There are many nice restaurants nearby, within walking distance. The only downside is that the hot water isn't very reliable; it often runs out while I'm washing. Also, the hair dryer isn't very powerful, so it takes a long time to dry my hair.But overall, the experience was excellent. The thoughtful gesture of turning on the air conditioning in advance, especially before check-in, was a real plus. Highly recommended!

name: Beyond the Palms – High-Tech 4BR Luxury Villa with Rooftop Jacuzzi
comment: We had a wonderful stay at The Tropical Door in Canggu and are happy to give it 5 stars. The home is extremely modern, beautifully designed, and very well kept. The staff was super friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. The rooms were stunning, and we especially loved the indoor-outdoor feel of the bathrooms. The technology throughout the villa was such a fun touch — from the ability to connect and play music in different areas of the home to the automatic toilets with lids that opened on approach, heated seats, and automatic flushing. It honestly reminded me of the smart features we experienced in Singapore. On top of that, the price felt like an absolute steal for the quality of the home, design, amenities, and overall experience. A couple small notes: the home wasn’t ready right at arrival because the previous guests checked out late, and we wish we could have gotten the projector working. Even with those issues, the overall experience was excellent.We’d absolutely recommend

name: Villa Akar – Guest Favorite 4BR Architectural Hideaway in Berawa
comment: Our stay at this Airbnb was absolutely wonderful and exceeded our expectations in every way. The property was exactly as described (if not better), beautifully maintained, and extremely clean. The interiors were thoughtfully designed, giving the space a very warm, comfortable, and premium feel which made us feel at home the moment we arrived. The host was incredibly helpful, responsive, and courteous throughout our stay. From smooth check-in arrangements to being available for any queries or assistance, the hospitality truly stood out. The attention to detail in maintaining the property and ensuring guest comfort was clearly visible. The location was also very convenient and peaceful, making it perfect for relaxation while still being accessible to nearby attractions and essentials. The amenities provided were excellent, and everything we needed during our stay was easily available. The overall vibe of the place was calm, cozy, and perfect for spending quality time with family.

name: Villa Golden – Modern Chic 2BR Villa Opposite FINNS Club
comment: We had an amazing stay at Villa Golden, it was exactly as pictured, if not more beautiful. We loved how private the villa was, even if you were on the top floor, there has been some palm trees planted for a stunning view as well as privacy.  Everything was spotless, it was in a great location, close to a lot of eateries (Milk and Madu and Ulekan Bali was a fave for us). I did misread the description of the Villa thinking it was right next to Finn’s, but it was the Finn’s old recreation centre that it was near (which is stated but I got my places mixed up). However, there was a free shuttle to Finns & Atlas running every 20mins right outside the Villa driveway so it was perfect. Our only fault was the fridge smelt the whole time we were there but it’s not an issue we raised with the cleaning staff as we were out most of the time, but otherwise I’m sure it would’ve been fixed asap if we did raise it! Cleaning staff were great.  Awesome stay. Thank you so much

name: Villa Surga – Serene 4BR Valley-View Sanctuary in Ubud
comment: We have really enjoyed our stay at Surga Villa. The path there had crashed, due to rain, and made up a smaller waterfall. It was a bit uncomfortable, and at the end of the holiday, some set up a street lamp so you could see where you went in the dark. TTD 'was upon arrival, and departure very helpful in driving suitcases the rest of the way on moped. Nice house, nice pool. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing and relaxing. As others have mentioned, the house is very open and farmers walk along the edge of the pool. We could put it down, but at first it seemed a little quirky. One single ranger was especially hugely cozy when he stuck his head by :)  Close to town/markets that were not far to the smaller supermarkets and restaurants.  TTD 'made a lot of their service and they certainly went an extra mile to meet needs and wishes :) We are trying out another city, on the next trip to Bali. But we would not hesitate to come to the villa again in Ubud. Thank you for a wonderful stay < 3

name: House Terra – Biombo-Designed 5BR Tropical Pool Estate in Pererenan
comment: The house is literally just like the photos, nicely built, very spacious, and super comfy. Great place for large group to gather. I really love the services provided and made available to us, such as having chefs to cook us dinner and breakfast in the house. We particularly love the dinner, it was one of the best we had throughout our stay in Bali. However the in house massage service was below par, probably can collaborate with other better partners.

name: Magnificent Canggu Estate – Prestigious 5BR Tropical Pool Villa in Central Canggu
comment: Mr G was easy to communicate from before the stay when I had even the silliest questions to when we were actually in the villa had needed things done. The villa itself is impeccable, clean and comfortable. After a crazy day/night in the busy Canngu we would be relieved to go ‘home’. Each bedroom and living area provided open space that was comfortable and spacious. The staff Putu and Nusa were both incredibly helpful each day with any of our needs. Putu helped us organise our laundry services for 7 girls haha, washed and dried every second day. She also was able to help me plan and breakfast for my mums birthday in the house. I can’t speak highly enough of both Putu and Nusas service to keeping our house clean during our stay as well. Thank you so much for having us here!! My friend is already planning to bring back her family to stay here. We didn’t walk anywhere from the villa, so if you are to stay the Gojeks/ Grabs are very helpful. Town is only 5min away and food can come to you!

name: Designer Beachside Villa – Ultra-Chic 4BR Coastal Retreat in Canggu
comment: We had the best stay at this villa in Bali 🤍 From the moment we arrived, everything was amazing. I mentioned before arriving that it was my birthday and the team surprised me with a cake and a beautiful little set up which was such a thoughtful touch. The villa itself was stunning, spacious and always kept spotless, housekeeping came every day which made the stay feel super relaxing and effortless. The host was also incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay, always replying quickly to any questions and helping organise taxis and transport whenever we needed it. Couldn’t recommend this place enough for a Bali trip with friends… thank you again for such a lovely stay!

name: Villa Daun – Guest Favorite 3BR Architectural Gem in Berawa
comment: I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs before, and usually the level of service and cleaning can be quite different from a hotel. But staying at Villa Daun genuinely felt like staying at a 5-star hotel. The villa was beautiful, extremely clean, and very well maintained. The location was perfect—close to everything we needed, while the villa itself was in a peaceful and quiet area with no noise or disturbance. What impressed us even more was the hospitality. Our flight was late in the evening, and after check-out they kindly allowed us to leave our luggage in their storage room at no extra charge. The staff were always friendly, welcoming, and very helpful throughout our stay. We really enjoyed our time here and the villa exceeded our expectations. If I come back to Bali, Villa Daun will definitely be my first choice. Highly recommended!

name: Cala Blanca – Mediterranean 4BR Tropical Villa in Pererenan
comment: I Can say the villa itself has a nice interior , but the size is a bit too small than i expected (when i saw from the pics). especially the bathroom area and layout really small no space to hang some clothes and only has one hook for towel.  they have security standby for 24hours though, basically the villa is inside small complex where they have maybe around 6 neighborhood villas in one area so your main door is facing right face to face to the other villa opposite you. the Staff is warm and friendly and the host also responsive!

name: The Bull House – Iconic 6BR Temple of Leisure in Seminyak
comment: Our stay at the villa was absolutely amazing from start to finish. The villa itself was incredibly clean, well-maintained, and had all the amenities one could desire. The location was perfect, and we felt safe and well taken care of throughout our stay. The staff at the villa were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home. They were always available to help with anything we needed, from arranging dry cleaning to navigating the area and even organizing our airport transfers. Their attention to detail and willingness to assist with everything made our stay truly memorable. We also had the pleasure of having a chef come to the villa, and the food was simply incredible. This added an extra layer of luxury to our stay, and we would definitely recommend it to others. Special thanks to Mr. G for his super fast response time and ensuring that everything was perfect. Our stay was truly a home away from home, and we can’t wait to come back the next time we visit Bali. Thank you, Mr. G

name: Berawa Breeze – Chic 4BR Wellness Oasis with Private Sauna in Berawa
comment: Absolutely no regrets choosing this villa for our family of 6! Everyone was extremely happy with our stay. A huge thank you to Mr G, who was amazing from the start. He helped coordinate our airport pick-up and was always quick to respond whenever we needed help, making everything so easy for us. The housekeeping was also spot on. Vina and the rest of the team came by daily, accommodated our requests and were always so friendly and welcoming. My mum and dad were especially happy with their service, and we genuinely felt very well taken care of. The villa itself was beautiful and easily one of the best I’ve stayed in Bali. We loved the layout, spacious garden, clean pool and how well-maintained everything was. It was perfect for our family to relax and spend time together. An easy 5-star stay! Beautiful villa, amazing hospitality and wonderful staff. Thank you Mr G, Vina and the entire team for making our stay so memorable! ❤️

name: Coco Bay – Grand 8BR Beachside Luxury Estate in Berawa
comment: It’s honestly not enough characters to express how amazing Coco Bay Villa was. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded expectations. I hosted a group of 15 people, and every single person had an incredible stay. Lelyana was my right hand throughout our stay. She seamlessly coordinated decor, dinners,  and massages. The entire staff made us feel so taken care of (special shoutout to Nanok and Putu). The villa was kept in pristine condition with daily cleanings, and having support and security around the clock gave us peace of mind. The buggy service was incredibly convenient for our group, making multiple trips to get us around with ease. Every detail felt intentional, including filtered water provided throughout the villa. The in-house chef was amazing, delicious breakfasts provided every morning and select dinners. The location is unbeatable, walkable to great restaurants and nightlife. This truly felt like our own private luxury hotel. 1000/10, an unforgettable experience

name: Villa Milana – Sunlit 5BR Mediterranean Haven in Canggu
comment: We had such a wonderful stay at Tropical Door Villa. From the moment we arrived, the team made us feel so welcome with their warm smiles and genuine hospitality. The villa itself is stunning - spacious, beautifully decorated with tropical touches, and very well maintained. The pool and garden were a true highlight, creating such a peaceful and private atmosphere that felt like our own little oasis. What we appreciated most was the attention to detail. The staff were always accommodating, quick to help with any requests, and went out of their way to make sure we were comfortable. The villa was spotless, the beds were cozy, and little touches like the daily cleaning and thoughtful setup made our stay extra enjoyable. The location is also perfect - tucked away enough for privacy and quiet, yet close to great cafés, restaurants, and attractions in the area. Overall, Tropical Door Villa exceeded our expectations in every way. I’d highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing stay.

name: Beachside Haven – Elegant 4BR Modern Villa Steps from Canggu Beach
comment: Property was exceptional, exceeding our expectations! Better in real life than photos, loved every bit & couldn’t fault the villa. Rooms were clean, spacious, with all having their own separate bathroom facilities & walk-in-robe. Felt like we were in a luxury resort with the amazing large pool, surrounded by lush green foliage, spacious outdoor lounge/dining area. There were indoor/outdoor surround sound speakers, which made it a nice chill vibe to relax. Indoor lounge was large, accommodating our two families of eight. We could close up all doors to prevent mosquitoes/insects from entering, though property additionally had citronella incense coils throughout which kept us mosquito free! Staff were always on call, so friendly & willing to assist with anything needed. They made us the most amazing continental breakfast with floating floral arrangement and decorated the bed with rose petals & balloons – we had a very happy birthday girl! This villa was PERFECT & better than a 10/10!!!

name: Wellness Estate Canggu – High-End 4BR Villa with Sauna, Ice Bath & Gym
comment: This place is perfect for a big group of family or friends We enjoyed our stay here, everything was at the tip of our fingers, this place is very central so 1 minute walk to the beach clubs, mini marts right next door, security at the entrance of the complex 24/7  Rooms all have air con, beautiful smelling hand soaps, shampoo, body wash and hair dryers. You have a full kitchen if you are planning to cook, filtered cold and hot water. The pool was always cleaned, you have the perfect amount of shade to relax and sun to tan anywhere outside.  Housekeeper Ayu and team were really helpful, we shared many laughs together, she also organised a massage when one of us got sick, and made an effort to make us a really early morning breakfast in-house before our tour we are so grateful to her and the team for that.  Mr G/Tropical Door can also organise drivers, if you are staying here I highly recommend you book your driver through him. Teja and Josh were sooo good!!!  Thank you Team

name: Villa Aless – Serene 3BR Tropical Pool Hideaway in Umalas
comment: We had such an amazing stay at this villa in Bali! From the moment we arrived, everything was perfect. The villa was beautiful, clean and spacious, with everything we needed for a comfortable and relaxing stay. The location was fantastic and made it easy to get around and explore Bali, while still feeling peaceful and private when we came back to the villa. The whole place was even better than we expected, and the attention to detail really made our stay special. The staff were incredibly friendly, helpful and welcoming, and nothing was ever too much trouble. We felt so well looked after throughout our stay. We absolutely loved our time here and would definitely stay again. We couldn’t recommend this villa enough for anyone looking for a beautiful, relaxing place to stay in Bali! 🌴🤍

name: Alua Loft – Bohemian 1BR Designer Sanctuary in Pererenan
comment: My stay at The Tropical Door was wonderful, and the reality truly matches the pictures! The only minor thing was the triangular window in the bedroom, which was covered or sealed. Near the pool, there’s a partition made of black fabric that gives privacy from the neighbors. The service was excellent—I got quick responses to all my inquiries. I requested different pillows, and they were provided the same day. Be careful with the road leading to the villa—it’s not in the best condition, but manageable for a small car or scooter. There’s no parking for cars, but that wasn’t an issue. All deliveries found the address easily. The villa is equipped with everything you need, and I wholeheartedly recommend this place for a comfortable and peaceful stay!

name: Villa Satiya – 5.0 Star 4BR Tropical Oasis in Pererenan
comment: My stay at The Tropical Door in Bali was a dream come true. The host was incredibly fast and proactive, addressing all my inquiries and ensuring every detail was perfect. The property is breathtaking, nestled in a serene and picturesque environment. The lush gardens, pristine pool, and beautifully designed interiors create an oasis of tranquility and luxury. Every morning, I woke up to stunning views and the soothing sounds of nature. The villa is impeccably maintained and thoughtfully furnished, blending modern amenities with traditional Balinese charm. The host’s dedication to guest satisfaction sets The Tropical Door apart. They were always available, offering helpful local tips and arranging activities that made my Bali experience unforgettable. I really recommend The Tropical Door, If you’re looking for a beautiful, serene, and perfectly managed place to stay in Bali, this is it. Five stars, without a doubt!

name: Villa Infinity – Grand 5BR Luxury Estate with 20m Pool in Umalas
comment: We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful villa celebrating my 55th birthday with a group of friends. The villa was spacious, comfortable and private, with plenty of room for everyone. The pool was a real highlight — large enough to properly swim, and we spent lots of time relaxing around it with drinks and good company. We also had massages at the villa, which was such a treat and made the whole stay feel extra special. The rooms were comfortable and the common areas worked perfectly for our group. The villa manager and team were lovely, responsive and very accommodating, helping us with whatever we needed. The location was convenient for restaurants, beach clubs and shopping, while still feeling peaceful when we returned to the villa. It was the perfect setting for a memorable birthday with friends, lots of laughter, relaxation and wonderful memories. We would definitely stay here again!
